# shc_vm (Data Source)

Reads an existing SHC VPS by service ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) The SHC service ID of the VPS to read.

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String)
- `ip` (String)
- `os_user` (String)
- `provisioning_state` (String)
- `status` (String)
